clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This fictional procedure covers hydrostatic qualification of a closed-loop training pipe spool. It is a synthetic test fixture and describes no real equipment.

clauses.title: Baseline Conditions
clauses.text: The test water baseline temperature is 20 C. Ambient humidity and spool material grade are intentionally not specified.

clauses.title: Equipment Rating
clauses.text: The training loop pressure rating is 3.0 MPa. The rating applies to the loop assembly.

clauses.title: Test Pressure
clauses.text: The required hydrostatic test setpoint is 2.4 MPa. Use the hose pressure limit in Table 3 as a component check.

clauses.title: Hold Period
clauses.text: Hold the target pressure for 30 minutes on each run. Clause 9 requires three repeated holds.

clauses.title: Instrumentation
clauses.text: Use gauge G-17 with a range of 0 to 4 MPa and accuracy of 0.02 MPa. The gauge calibration date is not recorded.

clauses.title: Acceptance Criteria
clauses.text: The maximum allowed visible leakage is 0 mL/min. Stop the test if any leakage is observed.

clauses.title: Flow Sequence
clauses.text: Follow the low, nominal, then high flow stages in Table 1. The low stage lasts 2 minutes and the nominal stage lasts 3 minutes.

clauses.title: Repeat Runs
clauses.text: Perform three pressure holds, each using the 30-minute hold period specified in Clause 5. Depressurize between runs.

clauses.title: Flush and Temperature
clauses.text: Flush for the minimum time in Table 2. The measured baseline was recorded in Clause 2; maximum return temperature is listed in Table 2.
